hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for all TripoolsLaunchFactory pools that enforces a 50% anti-snipe tax during a 6-second launch window for non-whitelisted buyers. Ordinary buys and sells follow a dynamic tiered tax schedule (cycling between the creator's base rate and fixed tiers), with 80% of taxes accruing to the pool creator and 20% sent directly to the protocol treasury in ETH.
